verdict.rationale: SAM.gov documents a first-party system-to-system channel. Software uses System Accounts, created through the "System Accounts" widget and approved, plus API keys tied to SAM.gov accounts and an API Extract for bulk retrieval, all on one public page. However, the evidenced APIs are read/retrieve only, and the enrollment path is a single line with no detail on approval steps or criteria. missing for 10: evidence that software can transact (submit or update data, not just retrieve it), a detailed published enrollment and approval process for system accounts, and independent or hands-on corroboration of system-account onboarding.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, a documented system-to-system channel exists for software to transact with the service (system accounts, transmitter programs, batch providers), with the enrollment path published

citations.quote: Users must create their System Account using the “System Accounts” widget and get it approved.
Individual (Personal) Accounts, System Accounts, API Key Rate Limits, and an API Extract for bulk retrieval — API keys are tied to SAM.gov accounts.
